title: Swapping numerator and denominator when finding a fraction of a quantity
statement: To find a/b of a quantity you divide the quantity by a and multiply by b.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: find a non-unit fraction of a whole-number quantity
evidence_patterns.signature: divides by the numerator and multiplies by the denominator

evidence_patterns.item_shape: find a unit fraction of a quantity
evidence_patterns.signature: divides by 1 and multiplies by the denominator

discriminators.vs_slip: The answer is larger than the original quantity for a proper fraction and the learner does not object. A slip is a wrong division or multiplication within the right method.

conflicts_with.label: CCSS 4.NF.B.4: multiply a fraction by a whole number

resolved_by.label: CCSS 4.NF.B.4: multiply a fraction by a whole number
CCSS 3.NF.A.1: understand a fraction 1/b as one part of a whole partitioned into b equal parts

sources.citation: Hart, K. M. (Ed.). (1981). Children's Understanding of Mathematics: 11-16. John Murray. (Concepts in Secondary Mathematics and Science project.)
sources.note: CSMS fractions: errors on 'fraction of a quantity' items.
